title: The Bad Air
text: The candles gutter, shrink, and burn blue. Your breath comes short and your heartbeat loud in your ears. The air down here is thin and wrong, and it tastes of old pennies, and the dead rats along the wall all died facing the way you came.

options.label: Hold your breath and hurry through.

outcomes.text: Lungs burning, vision going grey at the edges, everyone makes it.
Someone breathes. The air gets inside their head and starts rearranging things.

options.label: The sharpest nose follows a draught.

outcomes.text: A side passage, clean air, and something someone hid there.

options.label: Turn back and find another way.

outcomes.text: Another way, longer, and the taste of old pennies stays in your mouths all the way.
